paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Ze'ira. Jerusalem Talmud, first chapter of Berakhot: Rabbi Achaya; Pesachim, chapter 2: Achvah. See Ahavah bar Zeira, since Jerusalem-Talmud Achvah is Ahavah. They appear to be one.
